verdict.rationale: LM Studio offers llmster, a headless daemon with no desktop app required, which avoids the heavy Electron UI that community-13 complained about. It also offers on-demand model loading over the API. However, nothing in the pack measures or claims fast startup or time-to-first-inference, and on-demand loading means a request waits while the model loads. Missing for 10: any documented or measured cold-start time, evidence that llmster is a lightweight binary, independent hands-on corroboration of startup speed.
